abstract: This paper develops a simple and new approach for testing linear hypotheses about autocorrelations for time series with general stationary serial correlation structures. A practically important special case is the computation of robust confidence intervals for individual autocorrelations that do not require resampling methods. Inference is heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation robust (HAR) and allows innovations to be uncorrelated but not necessarily independent and identically distributed (iid). It is well known that the classic Bartlett (1946) formula can provide invalid inference when innovations are not (iid). Romano and Thombs (1996) derive the asymptotic distribution of sample autocorrelations under weak assumptions but avoid estimation of the variances of sample autocorrelations and suggest resampling schemes to obtain confidence intervals. As an alternative we provide an easy to implement regression approach for estimating autocorrelations and their variance matrices. The asymptotic variance takes a sandwich form which can be estimated using well known HAR variance estimators. Resulting test statistics can be implemented with fixed-smoothing critical values which reduce finite sample size distortions. Monte Carlo simulations show our approach is robust to innovations that are not iid and works reasonably well across various serial correlation structures. An empirical illustration using robust confidence intervals for autocorrelations of S&P 500 index returns shows that conclusions about market efficiency and volatility clustering during pre and post-Covid periods using our approach contrast with conclusions using traditional (and often incorrectly used) methods. We provide a Python implementation for practitioners that implements our approach: https://eastlansing.github.io/Robust_CI_Acf/
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种简单新颖的方法，用于检验具有一般平稳序列相关结构的时间序列自相关的线性假设。一个实际重要的特例是计算单个自相关的稳健置信区间，无需重采样方法。推断具有异方差性和自相关稳健性（HAR），允许创新项不相关但不一定独立同分布（iid）。众所周知，当创新项非iid时，经典的Bartlett（1946）公式可能导致无效推断。Romano和Thombs（1996）在弱假设下推导了样本自相关的渐近分布，但避免估计样本自相关的方差，并建议采用重采样方案以获得置信区间。作为替代，我们提供了一种易于实现的回归方法来估计自相关及其方差矩阵。渐近方差采用三明治形式，可利用众所周知的HAR方差估计器进行估计。所得检验统计量可采用固定平滑临界值实施，以减少有限样本尺寸失真。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，我们的方法对非iid创新项具有稳健性，并在各种序列相关结构下表现良好。一项实证示例使用S&P 500指数收益自相关的稳健置信区间显示，采用我们的方法得出的关于疫情前后市场效率和波动聚集性的结论，与传统（且常被误用）方法得出的结论形成对比。我们为实践者提供了实现该方法的Python代码：https://eastlansing.github.io/Robust_CI_Acf/
title: Robust Confidence Intervals for Autocorrelations of Stationary Time Series
title_zh: 平稳时间序列自相关的稳健置信区间

abstract: Agents frequently engage with multiple principals simultaneously – for example, when borrowing from several banks or peers. In such settings, principals typically possess less information about the agent’s ability or intentions (e.g., to repay a loan) and must rely on trust. This paper presents experimental evidence from trust games framed in a credit market context to examine the role of reciprocity in interactions involving multiple principals (lenders) and a single agent (borrower). Agents were asked to decide whether to act trustworthily and repay, or to default and act selfishly, after receiving the same credit amount from either one or multiple principals. The results show that reciprocity declines when the number of trusting principals increases. A key mechanism appears to be the reduced marginal harm that an agent’s default imposes on each individual principal. Additionally, agents seem less sensitive to the negative consequences of their actions when multiple principals are affected. These findings suggest that interactions involving multiple principals are behaviorally riskier than bilateral ones. The results have implications for the design of incentive structures in multi-principal-agent environments, such as crowdlending platforms.
abstract_zh: 代理人经常同时与多个委托人互动——例如，向多家银行或同伴借款时。在此类情境中，委托人通常对代理人的能力或意图（如偿还贷款）掌握较少信息，因而必须依赖信任。本文通过在信贷市场背景下设计的信任博弈实验，考察了涉及多个委托人（贷款人）与单一代理人（借款人）的互动中互惠性的作用。代理人从单个或多个委托人处获得相同信贷额度后，需决定是履行可信赖行为（偿还贷款）还是违约（采取自私行为）。结果表明，当信任代理人的委托人数量增加时，互惠性会下降。其关键机制似乎是代理人违约对每个委托人造成的边际损害降低。此外，当多个委托人受到影响时，代理人对其行为的负面后果似乎更不敏感。这些发现表明，涉及多个委托人的互动在行为层面比双边互动更具风险性。研究结果对多委托人-代理人环境（如众贷平台）中的激励机制设计具有启示意义。
title: Reciprocity in multiple principals – one agent interactions: experimental evidence
title_zh: 多委托人-单一代理人互动中的互惠性：实验证据

abstract: Abstract Federal and state‐owned public lands occupy a significant proportion of many U.S. urban regions, contributing to two highly‐valued, nontradable goods: viewscapes and outdoor recreational opportunities. Yet, public lands have not been adequately addressed in the urban quality‐of‐life (QOL) literature. We argue that much of the previous literature has (1) used a geographic level of aggregation that has not been extensive enough to capture all the public lands that influence wage and housing equilibria, (2) often defined public lands measures too narrowly and has excluded over 50% of public land influencing hedonic equilibria, and (3) has rarely attempted to control for public lands endogeneity when quasi‐experimental approaches are infeasible. Using GIS and Census data for U.S. urban areas, along with instruments rooted in the 19th century land disposal policies, we estimate how publicly owned federal and state lands contribute to urban QOL. Our preferred specifications are based on Bureau of Census defined Combined Statistical Areas that are linear in public land variables, and the results are robust regardless of geographic aggregation and model specification. Welfare calculations indicate that the annual urban household willingness‐to‐pay estimate for a one percent increase in public land ranges between $80.58 and $130.29. Our study contributes to the literature by establishing land grant railroads as an exogenous instrument for public lands and by providing a framework for evaluating the welfare consequences of proposed land exchanges and other changes in land ownership or management.
abstract_zh: 联邦和州所有的公共土地在美国许多城市区域中占据显著比例，为这些地区贡献了两种高价值且不可交易的商品：景观视野和户外休闲机会。然而，公共土地在城市生活质量（QOL）文献中尚未得到充分探讨。我们认为，以往文献大多存在以下问题：（1）使用的地理聚合层级不够广泛，未能涵盖所有影响工资和住房均衡的公共土地；（2）对公共土地的定义往往过于狭窄，排除了超过50%影响特征均衡的公共土地；（3）在准实验方法不可行时，很少尝试控制公共土地的内生性。利用美国城市区域的GIS和人口普查数据，以及根植于19世纪土地处置政策的工具变量，我们估算了联邦和州公共土地对城市生活质量的贡献。我们偏好的规格基于人口普查局定义的合并统计区，这些区域在公共土地变量上是线性的，且结果在地理聚合和模型规格变化下均保持稳健。福利计算表明，公共土地每增加1%，城市家庭年支付意愿估计在80.58美元至130.29美元之间。本研究通过将土地赠予铁路确立为公共土地的外生工具变量，并为评估拟议土地交换及其他土地所有权或管理变更的福利后果提供框架，为文献做出了贡献。
title: Public lands and urban quality of life
title_zh: 公共土地与城市生活质量
